**The Paving Season**

Every morning for thirty-one years, Dennis had walked the perimeter of Hollowbrook School before the students arrived, checking for broken glass, graffiti, the small damages the world inflicted overnight. He knew the grounds the way a doctor knows a body: which drain flooded in heavy rain, which wall the wind peeled paint from, which corner of the field stayed marshy until June.

So he noticed the first seedling on a Tuesday.

It stood in the scrubby grass behind the gymnasium—a rowan, no taller than his hand, staked carefully with a splint of bamboo and ringed with mulch. Someone had watered it recently; the ground was dark
reasoning_text:
Write ~1000 word story. Caretaker named e.g. Marek or just "Mr. Aldous"? Person planting: a student? A kid whose parent died? Make both sympathetic. Caretaker's job depends on the paving project going through; he's near retirement, needs the work, or he's proud of the school. Planter: a student who planted trees with a deceased parent, or grieving mother, or a kid doing it for eco reasons. Avoid villain. End with compromise—transplant the seedlings.

Write ~1000 words.
